## 1. Decision form
Add an n8n Form Trigger with:
- `upload_id` (from query string)
- `action` dropdown: Approve all / Deny / Retry section
- `section_id` (optional number; required when Retry section)

## 2. Optional status load
HTTP GET `{{$env.CSV_PIPELINE_API_URL}}/uploads/{{$json.upload_id}}/status`
Show per-section completed/failed/pending before choosing an action.

## 3. Route the action
Switch on `action`:
- Approve all → POST `/uploads/{id}/approve`
- Deny → POST `/uploads/{id}/deny`
- Retry section → POST `/uploads/{id}/sections/{section_id}/approve`

## 4A. Approve all
POST `{{$env.CSV_PIPELINE_API_URL}}/uploads/{{$json.upload_id}}/approve`

Expect:
- 200 + staging_dropped=true when every section completed
- 207 partial when some sections failed (staging kept; use status + retry section)
- 409 if another approve is running

## 4B. Retry one section
POST `{{$env.CSV_PIPELINE_API_URL}}/uploads/{{$json.upload_id}}/sections/{{$json.section_id}}/approve`

Use after a 207/partial run. Drops staging only when this finishes the last incomplete section.

## 4C. Deny
POST `{{$env.CSV_PIPELINE_API_URL}}/uploads/{{$json.upload_id}}/deny`

Drops staging + progress; production unchanged.

## 5. Show result
Form Ending for: approved, partial (list failed section_ids), section retried, denied, 409 busy, 404 missing.
